newsitem.title: MEXICO: Ispat Mexicana ups steel capacity to 3 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Ispat Mexicana ups steel capacity to 3 mln tonnes.

text.p: Ispat Mexicana, Mexican arm of Indian steelmakers Ispat International, plans to raise its steel production capacity in 1997 to three million tonnes from two million, said a report by brokerage Salomon Brothers.
Analysts Mauricio Reveco and Harald Liberge wrote in the report that Ispat was also planning to increase production to four million tonnes after 1997.
"The company is also studying the possibility of entering the hot-rolled and cold-rolled sheet market," the analysts wrote, citing Ispat International CFO Bhikam Agawal.
Ispat Mexicana has a plant at the Pacific coast steelmaking town of Lazaro Caardenas.
